<!-- Search existing issues and open PRs first. Use a specific, plain title without
     a category prefix. -->

## Problem

<!-- Identify the affected workload, metric, and practical impact. -->

## Reproduction and measurement

<!-- Include source/input, exact commands, measurement tool, run count, compiler
     revisions, optimization level, and relevant host/hardware/target details. -->

## Results

<!-- Compare baseline and observed values with units and variability. Link profiles
     or generated code when useful. Separate measurements from suspected causes. -->

## Scope

<!-- Describe the optimization boundary and correctness constraints, if known. -->

## Completion criteria

<!-- List repeatable measurements and correctness checks that demonstrate resolution.
     Do not invent a performance target without supporting measurements. -->
